            invokeai/frontend/webv2
            invokeai/version/invokeai_version.py
            .nvmrc
            .github/actions/install-frontend-deps
            .github/workflows/frontend-tests.yml

        with:

          path: invokeai/frontend/webv2/artifacts/architecture-performance
